user.title: Asterisk Manager Interface
user.description: Connect Home Assistant directly to Asterisk through AMI. The connection is validated before it is saved.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Asterisk/Issabel server.
data_description.username: Manager user configured in manager.conf / manager_custom.conf.
data_description.password: Secret for the AMI manager user.

features.title: Devices, entities and HT503
features.description: Choose protocols, extensions and entities. If no extension is selected, all discovered extensions from enabled protocols are included.

data_description.selected_endpoints: Select one or more discovered extensions. Leave empty to use all discovered endpoints.
data_description.extra_endpoints: Optional. Comma-separated endpoints such as PJSIP/200,SIP/300. A bare number is treated as PJSIP.
data_description.enable_ht503: When enabled, the next step asks for the HT503 address and password.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate AMI
reauth_confirm.description: Update the Asterisk Manager Interface credentials.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Asterisk AMI
reconfigure.description: Change the Asterisk/Issabel AMI connection. The new connection is tested before applying it.

ht503.title: Grandstream HT503
ht503.description: Configure local FXS/FXO status monitoring. HT503 access is tested before saving.

data_description.ht503_host: Local IP address or hostname of the Grandstream HT503.
data_description.ht503_password: Password used by the HT503 web interface.
data_description.ht503_poll_interval: How often to read FXS/FXO status, in seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Asterisk AMI.
error.invalid_auth: AMI authentication failed. Check username, password and manager permissions.
error.already_configured: This Asterisk AMI endpoint is already configured.
error.ht503_missing_host: Enable HT503 only after entering its host/IP address.
error.ht503_cannot_connect: Unable to log in to the HT503 or read its FXS/FXO status page.

abort.already_configured: This Asterisk AMI endpoint is already configured.

init.title: Asterisk options
init.description: Change protocols, extensions and entities. HT503 settings are shown in a separate step when enabled.

ht503.title: Grandstream HT503
ht503.description: Update local HT503 access and test FXS/FXO status before saving.

data_description.ht503_host: Local IP address or hostname of the Grandstream HT503.
data_description.ht503_password: Password used by the HT503 web interface.
data_description.ht503_poll_interval: How often to read FXS/FXO status, in seconds.

error.ht503_missing_host: Enable HT503 only after entering its host/IP address.
error.ht503_cannot_connect: Unable to log in to the HT503 or read its FXS/FXO status page.
